objective: Preallocate correlated subquery local-scope buffers from the known FROM/JOIN relation count.

tasks.title: Preallocate subquery local scope
tasks.result: Correlated subquery local-scope construction now reserves relation-name and column buffers from the AST relation count.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The relation count comes directly from the subquery SELECT FROM items and their JOIN lists.
The change preserves local relation-name collection, schema loading, prefixed column generation, and duplicate column filtering.
